_comment: Practice configuration. Worked example, not a recommendation: replace every number with your own. JSON rather than YAML so every script in this toolkit stays standard-library only.
_walk_away_note: Must equal the walk_away_day_rate computed by economics.py --floor from the costs, capacity and risk blocks above. Stored separately so Gate 0 runs without recomputing; Stage 0 verification checks they still match.

disqualifiers.reason: pressure to start without a written scope
contact must check with an unnamed party
prior suppliers described as incompetent with no self-implication
urgency out of proportion to the stated trigger
leads with rate before describing the problem
desired outcome changed between conversations — require a paid discovery phase
